title: Search all countertops before opening cabinets
description: When looking for target objects in a kitchen environment
content: Check every countertop surface first, as items are often placed there rather than inside closed cabinets.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two lettuce in fridge.

title: Search all locations before acting
description: When the target object is not immediately visible
content: Explore each accessible location systematically to locate the required object before attempting to interact with it.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a statue in sidetable.

title: Search systematically before opening containers
description: When looking for an object in a multi-container environment
content: Scan all visible surfaces and open containers first; only open closed containers after confirming the target is not already accessible.
